news.title: Dev Post 0.4.47
news.content: Endless Online 0.4.47 : Dev Post Auction House Dev Version 4.47 serves as a live runtime test focusing on Auction House scalability. Players can help by listing items; transactions are disabled for now. Event: Halloween in Aeven returns with daily invasions (Oct 14–Nov 2, 2025) featuring new rewards like Reaper doll and Bat Hat. Downloads: - EndlessOnline0447B.zip (~76,8mb) (80.586.827 bytes) — https://www.endless-online.com/client/0_04/EndlessOnline0447B.zip Dev Post URL: https://www.endless-online.com/devpost/0447.html

news.title: Dev Post 0.4.46
news.content: Endless Online 0.4.46 : Dev Post Details Smaller content changes and quick fixes following 4.45. Introduces NPC chat channel system for coordinated ambient dialogues. Adds beginner quest packs and medium-level quests. Overcharged Weekend event runs Sept 26–27. Dev Post URL: https://www.endless-online.com/devpost/0446.html

news.title: Dev Post 0.4.45
news.content: Endless Online 0.4.45 : Dev Post Item System Upgrades Focus on item system direction and upgrades. Adjusts drop logic and introduces safeguards to reduce burnout, laying groundwork for tiered item progression. Explains instancing, 'real' bound states, and item state taxonomy. Dev Post URL: https://www.endless-online.com/devpost/0445.html

news.title: Welcome to the Endless Online Patcher!
news.content: This patcher was created for RS Members and friends!

news.title: Introduction UPDATE B
news.content: Version 4.47 will serve as a live runtime test, gradually exploring best practices for handling a larger Auction House database load on the server. For those who want to help out, a few test patches will be available on this page. they will work with the current server version.
